problems: The blind guess (swan or goose with a long neck and rounded body) does not identify the intended subject. The title is 'Sekul — The Bailer', a gourd bailer with a handle, bowl and pouring water. The guess reads the handle as a neck and misses the water entirely.
The figure is the right way up: handle at top-left, bowl in the middle, lip at right, and drops falling downward.

Key stars are on the intended parts: 50583 and 50564 sit at the handle's top knob, 49583 is mid-handle, 49669 and 49637 are on the bowl's upper-left and left rim, 49029 is the bowl base, 47508 is the right rim, 46774 is the spout lip, and 47205 and 47310 are the falling drops.
The blue silhouette is a real outline and not a copy of the gold lines, but the spout is only a point at 46774 with no lip shape, so the pouring end reads weakly.
Labels collide: the top-left handle labels overlap each other, and 'right side of the gourd's rim' runs into 'the spout-lip at the far right'. 'Upper-left rim' also crosses the silhouette line.
The two drop loops are very small and detached from the lip, so the water reads as two separate blobs rather than a stream.
output.advice: Keep the star assignments; they already sit on the right parts. Redraw the silhouette so the shape is clearly a gourd bailer, not a bird. (1) Handle: a narrow arc from knob 50583 (approx. x=174, y=113) and its twin 50564 down through mid-handle 49583 (approx. x=244, y=186) to the join at rim 49669 (approx. x=237, y=297). Make it thicker and bend it slightly so it reads as a grip, not a neck. (2) Bowl: a wide, round gourd body below the join, passing through 49637 on the left (approx. x=240, y=343), base 49029 (approx. x=284, y=387) at the bottom, and right rim 47508 (approx. x=393, y=344), closing back to the join. The bowl should be the largest mass in the figure. (3) Spout: a short, clearly pointed lip at 46774 (approx. x=447, y=347) that tapers off the right rim, so the pouring end is visible. (4) Water: put the two drops, 47205 (approx. x=417, y=416) and 47310 (approx. x=411, y=467), in a small vertical stream below the lip, with teardrop shapes wider than the current loops. Move the labels: stagger the handle labels vertically and move the spout label to the right or below so it does not overlap the rim label."]
